test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter cluster in the same way as the second letter cluster is related to the first letter cluster.

GOVERN : VRONGE : : MOCKERY : ______.
solution:
Table shows the positional value of alphabets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d477c85f9f69924c1f556134d632d7303ece87f8be5a0322488f09d77ce3dd87.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

GOVERN : VRONGE 

 
• **GOVERN is arranged according to reverse alphabetical order from left to right.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4894ff7feec310d444d2cf92152d9ff7fc2edaa617b8a8705856765852a92f3a.png] 

Similarly,

MOCKERY : YROMKEC 

 
• **MOCKERY is arranged according to reverse alphabetical order from left to right****.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e549b493e7067462f469a35a85664cc8237e16b27f7e87b34966dadf6e106738.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 2".**
